newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia shares break index, volume records.
newsitem.headline: Russia shares break index, volume records.

text.p: Russian shares broke a number of records on Wednesday, pushing the Russian Trading System index and volume to historic highs.
The RTS index rose 5.68 percent to close at 447.94 on $100.27 million reported turnover, the NAUFOR brokers association said.

The index has been rising fairly steadily since mid-April, when it was below 300, and traders have said that new allocations by foreign investors and an improved economic outlook for Russia have been supporting prices.
Total daily market volumes are considered healthy at half the new record level.
